title: The Library of Unfinished Returns

features.name: returned-book tower
features.desc-on-touch: Stacks of books brought back half-read, their pages marked with uncertain hands. The tower grows taller as more readers understand that incompleteness is itself a form of reading — the kind that never stops.

features.name: catalogue shelves
features.desc-on-touch: Bright wooden shelves holding directory cards that list not what was finished, but what was chosen to remain unfinished. Each card is a small democracy: the book and its reader agreed to leave something unresolved.

features.name: reading room
features.desc-on-touch: An arch of coloured light where readers sit with half-finished sentences, learning the deepest skill: how to live in the gap between words. Each person here teaches the next that some texts end by becoming part of the reader, never resolved, only absorbed.

features.name: margin notes plaque
features.desc-on-touch: A glowing field of unread annotations: words left in the margins by people whose thoughts never made it to the main text. The archive collects these sideways readings. Some are more true than the book itself.

features.name: unbound pages
features.desc-on-touch: Loose sheets scattered like leaves, each one the ending that was never reached. They teach each other: an ambiguous sentence from one book completes a stray thought from another, and together they form truths neither book alone could hold.

inscription: here books teach each other what their readers left unsaid

file.name: Incompleteness_Index_Colour_Coded.env
file.note: A ledger of every half-finished return, organized by which colour of bookmark marked the reader's stopping point, and what colour was never used. The colours speak to each other in the margins.
